episodes.157166: A surface disturbance moved across the High Plains initiating the development of isolated thunderstorms during the afternoon hours. These storms produced strong thunderstorm wind gusts up to 68 mph and were able to blow over a semi truck traveling on I-70.

events.narrative: As an isolated thunderstorm moved east into Decatur County, a trained spotter measured a 68 mph wind gust with a Davis weather station. Key impacts: strong winds.

As isolated storms moved east along the I-70 corridor, outflow associated with the storms produced strong winds up to 60 mph which blew over an empty semi truck traveling on I-70 near mile marker 61. Key Impacts: strong winds, difficult driving conditions.
